Agenda
Item 1
Regional Business Review: Americas

The committee deliberated on the Regional Business Review: Americas. The core of the discussion was the trade-off between short-term cost savings and long-term strategic investment. A consensus was reached to proceed with the phased approach outlined in Exhibit A.

Motion

To approve for values: RESOLVED, that the Go-to-Market Committee approves the company's response to the shareholder proposal regarding Regional Business Review: Americas.

Moved: Hiwot Martin  •  Seconded: Cuong Amponsah
Vote: 3 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
HRIS Platform Assessment — Vendor Selection Update

The HRIS Platform Assessment — Vendor Selection Update was a review of the company's compliance with consumer protection laws. The committee reviewed the company's marketing practices and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To enter executive session: RESOLVED, that the meeting be adjourned.

Moved: Carmen Mwangi  •  Seconded: Hiwot Martin
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Internal Audit Plan for FY2012

Hiwot Martin walked the committee through the Internal Audit Plan for FY2012 proposal. The proposal aims to address long-standing issues affecting 143 employees in the 14 region. After a thorough debate on the budgetary impact and timeline, the committee moved to a formal resolution. All related materials were previously distributed as Exhibit C.
